concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated platform representing the AUV hardware and operational base.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A component within the AUV system responsible for managing and directing operations or behaviors.
A basic data type defined within the AUV_Module to represent simple values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV_Module that groups multiple values together.
A named value within a Composite Type that stores a specific data element.
A data field contained within an Interface that holds a specific piece of information.
An action or occurrence defined within an Interface that can be triggered and may have parameters and return values.
A defined operation within the AUV_Module that takes inputs and returns a computed output.

instances.description: The module that encapsulates the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV that uses the Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides sensor data to the AUV_Platform.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides actuator commands to the AUV_Platform.
The controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operator commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides input commands used by controllers such as AUV_Operator.
The Last Response Engine controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module that provides output commands used by controllers such as LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot.
The autopilot controller within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to direct AUV navigation.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer values.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real number values.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A field of type real representing the radial component of the SVec composite type.
A field of type real representing the polar component of the SVec composite type.
A field of type real representing the azimuth component of the SVec composite type.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id (all of type real), and obs_hdng of type SVec.
A field of type real representing the north-south relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the east-west relative distance in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the depth value in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type real representing the identifier of the obstacle in the Obstacle composite type.
A field of type SVec representing the heading of the obstacle in the Obstacle composite type.
A value of type SVec representing the heading measurement within the Sensors interface.
A value of type Obstacle representing the detected obstacle data within the Sensors interface.
An interface defined by AUV_Module (likely intended as Inputs) that defines events for task and mode management.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, signaling the end of a task.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an OCM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a MOM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an HCM operation.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current velocity.
An event in the Intpus interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type representing closeness data, recording horiz_cda and vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat.
A field of type real representing the horizontal close-distance alarm value in the Close composite type.
A field of type real representing the vertical close-distance alarm value in the Close composite type.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
